description: This file defines a PHP class ProspectsJjwg_MapsLogicHook that implements logic hooks related to mapping and geocoding for the Prospects module in a SugarCRM project. It initializes a mapping module and defines hooks for updating geocode information on certain events.

classes.name: ProspectsJjwg_MapsLogicHook
classes.description: A class that provides logic hook methods for updating geocoding information related to prospects using the jjwg_Maps module.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the jjwg_Maps property by retrieving module info.

methods.name: updateGeocodeInfo
methods.description: Logic hook executed before saving a prospect, triggers geocode info update if enabled.

methods.name: updateRelatedMeetingsGeocodeInfo
methods.description: Logic hook executed after saving a prospect, updates related meetings' geocode info if enabled.
